description: This file defines the WiFiDirectServicesList class, a ListFragment that displays a list of WiFi P2P services discovered in the app. It manages a custom adapter to show device names and statuses, and interacts with the activity through a DeviceClickListener interface to initiate connections.

classes.name: WiFiDirectServicesList
classes.description: A ListFragment that displays available WiFi Direct services published by nearby devices. It includes an inner adapter class and interfaces for device interaction.

classes.name: WiFiDevicesAdapter
classes.description: Custom ArrayAdapter to bind WiFiP2pService objects to list item views, displaying device name and status.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the list fragment when the view is created.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list adapter with an empty list of WiFiP2pService objects and attaches it to the list.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicking on a list item; invokes activity callback to connect to the selected device and updates UI.

methods.name: WiFiDevicesAdapter
methods.description: Constructor for the custom list adapter.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Binds WiFiP2pService data to the list item view, setting device name and status text.

methods.name: getDeviceStatus
methods.description: Converts WiFiP2pDevice status codes into human-readable strings.
